warning: SPOILERS: hooks marked ⚠ reveal secrets of the story. Players who want to discover them in play should not open them.

hooks.title: The Two Princesses
hooks.premise: Anastasia and Isabel are building networks of capable supporters through academy relationships.
entry_points: A student receives two incompatible invitations.
A competition result makes a student's loyalty politically valuable.
A rumour threatens the reputation of one princess's allies.

hooks.title: Steel and Circles
hooks.premise: The Valenheart and Caldwin houses compete for prestige as leading martial and magical families.
entry_points: A public tournament pits students from both houses against one another.
A joint mission forces martial and magical specialists to cooperate.
A professor seeks a fair test that neither house can easily control.

hooks.title: Merit Against Lineage
hooks.premise: A capable commoner encounters barriers that the academy's official merit ideal does not remove.
entry_points: A ranking dispute reveals unequal access to training resources.
A noble offers support with strings attached.
A club must choose between a talented newcomer and a prestigious candidate.

hooks.title: Rumours at the White Rose
hooks.premise: A gala, club event or rumour network turns information into social currency.
entry_points: A rumour is true but misleading.
A source sells the same information to rival factions.
An event exposes a private connection between students.

hooks.title: A Trace from the Abyss
hooks.premise: An unusual magical disturbance suggests Miasma; its source and motive are not known at first.
entry_points: A field team returns with a damaged mana circuit.
A harmless-looking object produces a corruptive reaction.
A pattern of missing supplies points towards an illicit ritual.

hooks.title: When a Celestial Appears
hooks.premise: The appearance of one of the Four Celestials should substantially change the stakes rather than simply serve as a cameo.
entry_points: A crisis exceeds ordinary academy staff.
A research discovery draws Ethera's interest.
A threat near the frontier attracts Carne or Seriel.

hooks.title: ⚠ SPOILER — The Saintess's Prophecy
hooks.premise: Aria was sent to the academy because of a divine prophecy, and secretly hunts the Demon God Cult there. The exact prophecy is left to the narrator, but it ties the academy to the cult's plans.
entry_points: Aria asks the protagonist an odd question about a dream or a sign.
A purification at the chapel reveals a trace of Miasma.
An envoy from Lumina brings a new reading of the oracle.

hooks.title: ⚠ SPOILER — Acolytes Among Us
hooks.premise: The Demon God Cult is rooted in the academy: Acolytes hide among the students and recruit more with promises and pacts, mostly sealed by the Apostle Cartia. The Apostle Beradin is infiltrated in the academy itself. Which students are Acolytes is decided by the narrator in each story; Chloe Brightwell is a possible candidate, linked to the Sin Bishop Aris.
entry_points: A student suddenly gains power far beyond their rank.
Someone offers the protagonist a deal that seems too good.
A classmate disappears for a night and comes back changed.

hooks.title: ⚠ SPOILER — The Fall of a Celestial
hooks.premise: Carne, Commander of the Imperial Guard, is a strongly likely target for corruption by the Demon God Cult. If it happens (the narrator decides, and it does not happen every time), she becomes an antagonist of the hero. Seriel appears as an ally in this plotline.
entry_points: Carne's blood-red Aura feels heavier and darker than before.
Imperial Guards die in an unexplained massacre.
Lilia confides that she fears Carne more and more.
stakes: the balance of the Four Celestials

hooks.title: ⚠ SPOILER — The Host of the Spirits
hooks.premise: Sia is destined to become the Host of the Spirits: an exceptionally powerful mage, able to join the Celestials if her story progresses far enough. Rena, sent by Ethera to find great magical talents, may notice her.
entry_points: Sia's spirits act on their own to protect someone.
An instrument of the Magic wing reacts wildly to Sia.
Rena takes an unusual interest in Sia.
stakes: the cult's interest in such power

hooks.title: ⚠ SPOILER — Shadows of Valenheart
hooks.premise: Lilia is secretly jealous of Laris, who comes from a fallen branch yet beats her in every duel; Laris, secretly tasked with protecting Lilia, never notices. Lilia also hates and fears Carne, her adoptive relative, and trains to one day be strong enough to expel her from the family.
entry_points: Lilia loses another duel to Laris in front of everyone.
Laris turns up wherever Lilia goes, a little too often.
Carne visits the academy.
